description: Election Commission - R. M. Sanjeewa Siriwardhana was selected as the member of the Kegalle Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government body (Kegalle Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process, nomination of a candidate by a political party, and declaration of a selected member to fill a vacancy created by a member ceasing to belong to their party. This falls squarely under Election-related matters as defined in Type 7.
